title: What Glory It Is to Say
lyrics:
What glory it is to say
That Jesus hath saved me,
For truly I speak the truth;
I tell it again that Jesus alone saved me,
And this is the truth indeed.

CHORUS: The death of Christ
Was my salvation,
His death took away my grief;
All of my sins
He hath forgiven,
My soul is made glad in Jesus.

The life that I have
I owe unto Jesus,
And I speak that which is the truth;
I bless His name with deep devotion
Throughout all eternity.

The joy that I feel Jesus gave unto me,
My cup is running over;
He blotted out my sins,
He took away my grief,
Today I rejoice in liberty.

title: In the Business of the King
lyrics:
In the business of the King, Jehovah,
It is meet that we should labor,
It is meet that we should labor,
Preaching the truth.

CHORUS: Labor in the Lord
Is labor of great worth;
Let us labor more and more,
Let us labor in love.

In the spiritual work
It is meet that we should labor,
It is meet that we should labor,
Proclaiming liberty.

The world liveth without holiness,
It is meet that we should labor,
It is meet that we should labor,
In the name of Jehovah.

title: I Am a Pilgrim
lyrics:
I am a pilgrim here
In this sorrowful world,
I have no home wherein to dwell;
I walk along with
Many a hardship,
But in heaven is my home.

CHORUS: I must strive to have my home
With Jesus my King;
I must suffer that I may rejoice.
A crown is waiting
Yonder in heaven,
Which, if I be faithful,
I must surely win.

Winter and tempest
Beat upon my life,
Oh, what pain, what grievous pain!
Sore wearied I go
And filled with bitterness,
All to behold my Savior.

In the midst of my sorrow
I feel the love of Christ,
Which maketh me love Him more and more;
It is a blessing
To bear the cross of Christ,
'Tis the glory of my life.

title: Let Heavenly Fire Come
lyrics:
Let heavenly fire come,
And preside o'er the assembly
Of the people of the Lord;
/:/ Let the fire come /:/
To the spiritual assembly.

CHORUS: Holy fire of God,
Come to this gathering,
Descend today here
With heavenly power.

God answered by fire
Unto the prophet Elijah,
When he prayed unto God;
/:/ Let fire come /:/
Today we seek blessing.

Let heavenly fire come,
And consume the offering
That is upon the altar;
/:/ Let fire come /:/
To the spiritual feast.

title: Jesus Gave unto My Life
lyrics:
Jesus gave unto my life
A hope that changed my whole being;
He saved my soul by His blessed grace,
He chose me that I might fulfill His will.

CHORUS: Naught is more noble,
Naught is more worthy,
Than to consecrate to Jesus Christ
Our lives;
Sorrows and thorns upon my way,
Yet sanctifieth me
His blessed presence.

I understand, yea, what it costs
To follow the steps of Jesus in His labor;
Yet what care I? I will press on
With Christ before me,
And by His grace I shall be more than conqueror.

With a thousand lives I could not repay
What Thy love on Calvary did for me;
My life and faith are surrendered to Thy service,
As an offering
Consecrated unto Thee alone.

My whole life I consecrate to Thy service,
My precious Savior;
Hereafter my brow shall wear a laurel of glory,
For every soul that I rescue through Thy love.

title: I Await the Victory
lyrics:
I await the victory
Of Jesus my Savior;
I run in the stadium
To obtain a prize.
I await the victory
In the name of the Lord;
Though it cost me my life,
I shall behold Christ the King.

CHORUS: But I trust in God
That naught shall befall me,
For Christ defendeth me
And never will forsake me.

I hope to go to heaven
And behold my Savior,
And join with the righteous
Who have been faithful unto Him.
Though I suffer for the cause
Of Jesus my Savior,
I shall behold my Master
In His glory and majesty.

The way unto heaven
Is of trials and pain;
The valiant press forward
For the kingdom of the Lord.
Though it cost us our life,
Let us not look behind;
We will press ever onward
Toward the heavenly mark.

title: Jesus Christ Invites Us
lyrics:
Jesus Christ invites us
Unto the kingdom of His love,
Where the radiant countenance of the Lord
Shineth brighter than the sun.

CHORUS: Come, come, come, sinner,
Come, come, come unto the Lord,
To partake of love and virtue.

At the throne of the Lamb
There is joy without equal;
Many angels sing without ceasing
Unto the heavenly Father.

Great joy is in store
For the sinful man
Who draweth near in repentance to the Creator,
To yield Him his heart.

title: I Have Joy, Joy
lyrics:
I have joy, joy
In my heart,
In my heart,
In my heart.
I have joy, joy
In my heart,
Glory be unto our God.

I have joy,
Peace and gladness in my heart,
In my heart, in my heart.
I have peace and gladness, in my heart,
Glory be unto our God.

I have Christ,
Christ within my heart,
In my heart, in my heart,
I have Christ,
Christ within my heart,
Glory be unto our God.

title: I Would Speak to You
lyrics:
I would tell you of the love of Christ,
For in Him I found a friend both strong and true;
By His grace He transformed my whole life,
All that in this life I am, I owe to Him.

CHORUS: No one could ever love me like Christ,
Incomparable is His friendship;
He alone could redeem me from sin,
Through His love and His goodness.

My soul was full of woes and sorrow,
Filled it was with misery and grief;
With tenderness Christ reached out His hand,
And guided me along the path of love.

Every day He comes to give me new strength,
To my heart He imparteth sweet peace;
I shall not fathom why He came to save me,
Until in heaven I behold His face.

title: There Is No Fear
My Righteousness in the Heavens
My Soul, Like a Ship
lyrics:
My soul, like a ship,
Is seen rowing upon the waters,
Against the winds of a cruel tempest...
And though the strength of my soul seemeth
To fail,
Jesus the Master cometh to my aid,
And causeth me to triumph.

CHORUS: Christ saith unto me:
I am with thee,
I will never leave thee,
I will ever defend thee;
Keep rowing onward,
And thou shalt triumph by faith.

My soul, like a bruised reed, is seen to bend,
And seemeth now about to break;
Yet the grace of Christ is seen to shine,
And is poured forth like myrrh upon my soul,
And causeth me to triumph.

My soul, like a bird that fleeth from its hunter,
To be delivered from bondage,
So in all things my soul crieth unto Jesus,
Who by His grace sustaineth my soul,
And causeth me to triumph.

title: My Beloved Cometh
lyrics:
My Beloved cometh upon the mountains,
Go ye forth to meet Him,
And give Him welcome,
And declare unto Him with joy
Your gratitude,

CHORUS: Blessed King that cometh,
Hosanna in the highest!
My Beloved cometh in the clouds,
He cometh for me, oh, what glory!

Keep your lamps trimmed and burning,
And pray without ceasing,
Anointing your souls
With the excellent ointment
Of the Comforter.

In the fulness of glory cometh
My beloved Jesus Christ,
With palms and crowns,
For the beloved children,
The workmanship of His love.

title: Glory to Thee, Jesus Divine
lyrics:
Glory to Thee, Jesus divine,
Glory to Thee for Thy goodness,
Glory eternal to Thy tender mercies,
Dearest Savior.

CHORUS: Glory, glory, hallelujah,
Glory, glory, hallelujah, glory,
Glory, hallelujah to our Savior.

Thou didst love me with tenderness,
And for me on the cross Thou diedst,
With tenderness Thou didst cherish me,
Dearest Savior.

I have faith only in Thy death,
For thereby Thou didst save me,
Everlasting life Thou boughtest for me,
Dearest Savior.

We shall see Thee in Thy kingdom,
We shall go to dwell with Thee,
In Thy presence we shall rejoice,
Dearest Savior.

Take courage, Christian courage,
Christ is thy best Friend;
He will take thee unto Himself,
Jesus is thy Shepherd.

title: When the Trumpet Sounds
lyrics:
When the trumpet of the Lord sounds
In that final, solemn day,
And the eternal dawn shall break in radiant light;
When the nations of the saved
Reach their homeland over there,
And the roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.

CHORUS: /:/ When the roll is called up yonder, /:/
To my name I gladly will respond.

On that day devoid of shadows,
When no death shall ever be,
And His glory the Savior shall impart;
When the called ones shall enter
Unto their celestial home,
And the roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.

Let us labor for the Master
From the dawning's early gleam;
Let us ever speak His love and faithful care;
When all earthly things shall perish,
And our labor cease below,
And the roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.

title: The Chosen of the Lord
lyrics:
The chosen of the Lord
Go swiftly forth to fight,
For they follow the Shepherd,
The heavenly Lamb as their General.

CHORUS: Strive on, strive on,
Overcoming evil with good,
And God shall grant us a home.

Faithful soldiers of the Creator,
Fight on without fainting,
Battling without ceasing,
Battling with courage until ye triumph.

With the divine Emmanuel,
Naught shall we lack;
With His weapons of truth
New strength He will grant us
To overcome.

title: Held by the Hand
lyrics:
Held by the hand of my Lord,
I will walk trusting and without any fear;
Held by His hand I will not fear,
Because in His holy name
I shall overcome.

CHORUS: If Christ goeth with me I will follow on,
Held by His hand I never shall fall;
For His holy hand is mighty in power,
And the world I shall overcome.

In the narrow way I will walk;
My Savior saith unto me: I will help thee;
The King in His beauty I shall behold,
Unto eternal rest I shall attain.

If Christ protect me faithful I will be,
The world and its pleasures I will cast away;
Yet without Jesus Christ I can do nothing,
But with His holy help
I shall triumph.

title: There Is a Good Seed
Jesus Is My Sovereign King
lyrics:
Jesus is my sovereign King,
My joy is to sing forth His praise;
He is King, yet He views me as a brother,
He is King, and He imparts to me His love;
Leaving His throne of glory,
He came to lift me from the mire,
And I am happy, yea, I am happy in Him.

Jesus is my longed-for Friend,
And in darkness or light He ever goeth;
Patient and humble at my side,
His help and consolation He giveth me;
Therefore steadfastly I follow Him,
Because He is my King and my Friend,
And I am happy.

Lord, what could I ever give Thee
For so great goodness unto me?
Is it enough to serve Thee and love Thee?
Is yielding myself unto Thee all?
Then accept Thou my life,
Which unto Thee alone is surrendered;
For I am happy,
Yea, I am happy in Thee.

title: Christ Gives Us Light
lyrics:
Christ giveth us light,
With His holy majesty;
Christ giveth us light
With His gracious hand.

CHORUS: He is the light, He is the light,
My Jesus is the light;
Fear ye not, for with you walketh
He who died upon the cross.

We shall not stumble,
For our Shepherd goeth before,
Ever lighting
Our footsteps with His love.

He is the Light of the world,
Our holy Savior;
He is the light that illumineth
Whosoever seeketh salvation.
